text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
One day, we're discussing racing and<n>idol plans
after training like usual,<n>when...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Lately, I've been thinking about trying<n>an event
aside from street shows.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
The reason being is that I want to<n>explore ways of
introducing<n>Tomakomai's charms to larger
audiences and getting them to visit.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I think the first step is putting<n>Tomakomai on the
map for all the<n>folks out there... but what do you
think?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: An event would be a good way to put Tomakomai's name out there, but ithinges on how many people we canbring in. Or actually...
choice_data_list: Let's apply for a spot in a big music festival!
Let's apply for a spot in a big music festival!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Joining an existing event will let her<n>appeal to a
massive audience.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
By "big music festival," do you mean<n>one of those
massive events with all<n>the popular bands and
idols?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I think that might be tough.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
You need to have a certain amount of<n>popularity
and accomplishments<n>already.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
The planners aren't going to entrust a<n>slot to some
no-name self-proclaimed<n>"idol" from the sticks, are
they?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Even if I somehow did get in... thecrowds would be there to hear mesing, not advertise Tomakomai to them.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
It'd be really hard to get<n>festival-goers to take a
genuine<n>interest in Tomakomai. And I'm<n>neither
popular nor accomplished<n>enough to get people
curious about<n>my personal interests.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: She's right—I didn't think this through.Of course we can't just hop into aceleb event and magically bring infloods of tourists... We need a realplan.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Well, let's put a pin in it and<n>come back to
brainstorming later.<n>Thanks for letting me bounce
ideas<n>off you!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Something that'll pull a crowd, but<n>also promote
Tomakomai effectively...<n>I really can't think of
anything.

text_block_list.name: Aspiring Dancer A
text_block_list.text:
Sweet! With these dancing skills, I'll<n>be world
famous in no time! They'll<n>put me on TV, and then
I'll be a<n>superstar!

text_block_list.name: Aspiring Dancer B
text_block_list.text:
Oh please. Like the studios would air<n>you. It's not
just about raw potential,<n>you need to work hard
and get lucky.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(Exactly. Show business is<n>notoriously hard to get
into.)

text_block_list.name: Aspiring Dancer A
text_block_list.text:
Awww, c'mon, why are you being so<n>serious
about it, you killjoy. It's a<n>dream, so you don't
have to take<n>everything so literally.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
The crowds would be there to hear<n>me sing, not
advertise Tomakomai to<n>them.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
It'd be really hard to get<n>festival-goers to take a
genuine<n>interest in Tomakomai. And I'm<n>neither
popular nor accomplished<n>enough to get people
curious about<n>my personal interests.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Was I taking the suggestion... too<n>literally?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
T-thinking back, Trainer did seem a bit<n>bummed.
Maybe I shouldn't have<n>shot down the festival
idea that<n>harshly...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: (Trainer's on my side. They like<n>Tomakomai too...)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(They've been so understanding of<n>my local idol
efforts, and promised to<n>help me with them...)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Agh, I can't believe I was so rude!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I'm heading back to my room when I<n>spot
someone waiting for me<n>outside—Hokko Tarumae. I
wonder<n>what's up...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Um, h-hi, Trainer. Good, uh, good work<n>today!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I've been brainstorming ideas for an<n>event we
could hold ourselves, and<n>since she's here I guess
I'll tell her<n>my thoughts.
choice_data_list:
Hey, Tarumae. I was just thinking about what you
said earlier.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Ah! I, I'm so sorry!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Well, you've been so, so supportive<n>of my street
shows, and I couldn't<n>possibly ask for more.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
So, I'm fine as-is! I'll just keep on<n>slowly working
my way up, one<n>street show at a time! That's all I
wanted to say!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
...That's fair enough. There's no<n>shortcut to
success, so I guess she's<n>shelving the event idea
in favor of<n>slow, steady progress.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
While she's doing her best at those<n>street shows,
though... I think I want<n>to study up on promotion
strategies<n>we can work up to.
